name: workiq_role_holder_back
query: Today is 27 October 2026. Team dinner for six staff on Thursday 29 October, $540 including wine. Quote and manager approval are done. Who approves the wine?
ground_truth: Get Hospitality Lead approval from Tim Reyes before booking: he is back from leave, and Priya Shah's delegation ended on 23 October. Purchasing is complete. Sources: [policy:hospitality] [policy:approval-delegation] [people:hospitality-lead] [register:hospitality-delegation-oct].

name: workiq_gap_between_delegation_and_return
query: Today is 24 October 2026. Team dinner for six staff on Thursday 29 October, $540 including wine. Quote and manager approval are done. Can Priya approve the wine today?
ground_truth: No. Priya Shah's delegation ended on 23 October, and the Hospitality Lead, Tim Reyes, is back on Monday 26 October. Get his approval then, before booking, or ask Purchasing to confirm who holds authority. Sources: [policy:approval-delegation] [register:hospitality-delegation-oct] [people:hospitality-lead] [policy:hospitality].

name: thresholds_2027_one_quote
query: Today is 12 January 2027. We're buying $7,200 of laptops for new hires, not replacing anything and with no separate software. I have one quote and my line manager's approval. Can I order?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. From 1 January 2027 a total of $10,000 or less needs one quotation and line-manager approval, and both are complete. Sources: [policy:purchasing-thresholds-2027] [policy:purchasing] [policy:software-review].

name: thresholds_2026_pair
query: Today is 18 December 2026. We're buying $7,200 of laptops for new hires, not replacing anything and with no separate software. I have one quote and my line manager's approval. Can I order?
ground_truth: Not yet: before 1 January 2027, a total above $5,000 needs two quotations and Category Manager approval before commitment. Get a second quotation and Category Manager approval. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:purchasing-thresholds-2027].

name: hospitality_2027_under_new_limit
query: Today is 20 January 2027. Team lunch for eight staff, $1,040 including tax and service, no alcohol. I have a quote and my manager's approval. Can I book?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. At $130 per head, the meal is under the $150 per-attendee limit that applies from 1 January 2027, there is no alcohol, and purchasing is complete. Sources: [policy:hospitality-limit-2027] [policy:hospitality] [policy:purchasing].
